name: horde.predator_lifecycle_abstract_to_physical_mcw
description: Current-source native lifecycle route: stage exactly one identified, route-bearing abstract writhing-stalker horde at five OMT, preserve its saved abstract footing, then use only normal live movement/wait actions to bring that same threat into the loaded map and observe one physical consequence.

steps.label: settle_loaded_map_before_abstract_predator_stage
steps.expected_visible_fact: the disposable live map is settled before the one permitted setup-only abstract threat spawn

steps.label: stage_one_abstract_writhing_stalker_five_omt
steps.expected_visible_fact: the debug overmap-threat submenu returns to the live map after staging one identified, route-bearing abstract writhing stalker five OMT away

steps.label: audit_one_abstract_stalker_stage_receipt
steps.abort_reason: the same-run native debug log did not identify the one permitted five-OMT writhing-stalker abstract spawn
steps.expected_visible_fact: the native debug log records exactly the selected abstract-stalker setup option

steps.label: audit_player_save_mtime_before_abstract_predator_stage_save
steps.expected_visible_fact: the saved-player mtime baseline is captured before the abstract-stalker footing writeback

steps.label: save_abstract_predator_stage_native_boundary
steps.objective: Use the advertised native Save and quit action and its confirmation, rather than the fixture's ordinary Save keybinding, to serialize the abstract-stalker footing.
steps.expected_visible_fact: the bound native Save and quit confirmation serializes the one permitted abstract-stalker footing

steps.label: audit_player_save_mtime_after_abstract_predator_stage_save
steps.abort_reason: the bound native Save and quit action did not write the staged abstract-stalker footing

steps.label: confirm_native_process_exit_after_abstract_predator_stage_save
steps.objective: From the native main menu produced by the accepted save boundary, invoke only its advertised Quit action and confirmation to end this exact saved-world process.
steps.expected_visible_fact: the native process exits only after the saved abstract-stalker footing is written

steps.label: await_native_process_exit_after_abstract_predator_stage_save
steps.expected_visible_fact: the native process exit is observed after its accepted Quit confirmation

steps.label: reload_abstract_predator_saved_world_hud
steps.expected_visible_fact: the saved abstract-stalker world reloads into ordinary gameplay

steps.label: audit_exactly_one_abstract_stalker_before_live_transition
steps.abort_reason: saved horde_map did not retain the staged identified writhing stalker with its player route in the five-OMT abstract distance band after the native save/reload boundary and before any normal live action
steps.expected_visible_fact: saved horde_map contains one identified, route-bearing abstract writhing-stalker entry in the five-OMT distance band after reload and before the live transition

steps.label: operate_abstract_predator_to_physical_transition
steps.objective: Use only advertised normal movement and wait actions after the reloaded audited abstract footing. Travel until the staged stalker enters the loaded map, record its durable native identity and position, then advance past any observed cooldown through a bounded ordinary wait. Do not finish on materialization alone: preserve either a same-identity native position delta or a native attack/damage receipt after handoff as the game-owned physical consequence. Do not stage, spawn, or inject another predator after the initial setup receipt.
proof_targets: saved abstract stalker footing after native save/reload
one post-cooldown same-identity native position delta or attack/damage receipt after handoff
invariants: the setup-only debug action receives no gameplay credit
no local monster spawn after abstract staging
no injected attack or target knowledge
materialization, elapsed time, and an unchanged actor position alone are not a physical consequence

evidence_contract.claim: an initially abstract writhing-stalker horde can hand off once into a physical native actor, which then produces a game-owned physical consequence
evidence_contract.writeback_note: the initial debug spawn is setup-only; only the subsequent native handoff and physical consequence can establish feature behavior
